hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q '\.r2-secrets\.sh' || exit 0; echo 'Blocked: .r2-secrets.sh holds the R2 keys; never read, source or print it. pnpm eval:data exports it on its own; wrap any other R2 script in bash scripts/with-r2-keys.sh. If it is missing, create it with: bash scripts/r2-secrets-init.sh' >&2; exit 2
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh) command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || exit 0; shellcheck "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; }
